accessibility.short_alt: Diagram of one pre-mRNA containing exons E1, E2, and E3 and introns I1 and I2, with two arrows to mature mRNA products labeled E1-E2-E3 and E1-E3.
accessibility.long_description: A pre-mRNA is shown as five consecutive labeled segments: exon E1, intron I1, exon E2, intron I2, and exon E3. One arrow points to mature mRNA 1, whose consecutive segments are E1, E2, and E3. A separate arrow points to mature mRNA 2, whose consecutive segments are E1 and E3.
accessibility.answer_leakage_note: Candidate v2 was rejected because a footer explicitly stated the assessed different-exon-combinations mechanism. Candidate v3 removes that footer while retaining a literal description of the visual relationships. Independent grading and accessibility review remain required.

technical_evidence.surface: local static review page in the Codex in-app browser
technical_evidence.desktop: Candidate and exact learner prompts rendered together without observed clipping.
technical_evidence.narrow_360px: Measured 360 CSS-pixel viewport and 360-pixel document scroll width after remediation; the dense gate table is contained in a keyboard-focusable scroller.
technical_evidence.in_page_200_percent_simulation: Learner preview font measured 32 px, image scrolled within its figure, and the document retained zero page-level horizontal overflow.
technical_evidence.image_unavailable_fail_closed: The figure was hidden, a focused role=alert appeared, and both response textareas plus the simulated submit control were disabled.
technical_evidence.keyboard_semantics: DOM inspection confirmed labeled response controls, semantic headings and tables, a focusable missing-image alert, and focusable overflow containers. Independent assistive-technology review remains open.
